scope: Offline-only rerun of the S/R and 15-minute-E2 inputs on the retained, family-specific absolute-EV dual-MC1 contract. No live, canonical, execution, policy, or frozen model artifact changed.

causality.score_and_map_contract: Each arm uses the retained BCF and current-v5 score surfaces, but independently refits their absolute rich-policy-EV MC1 maps. The HGB configuration, p02/p98 target clip, score-band coordinate, 21-day prior-resolved shift, dual +50 admission, BCF-EV priority and constrained portfolio are fixed.
causality.comparison_baseline: The frozen historical map is context only because its exact pre-February BCF score warm-up ledger was pruned. C0_refit_core_postfeb is the sole delta baseline and shares the post-February score/policy substrate with every input arm.
causality.sr_inputs: Only causal_sr_heads_oof_20260830_v3_entrypivotfix is merged. Missing S/R rows remain model missingness plus sr_snapshot_available, never an eligibility change; oracle S/R outputs are not read.
causality.e2_inputs: The 70-field 15-minute proxy is materialised from the complete target-free February-July candidate union before outcomes are joined. Every monthly E2 fit uses only prior four-month rows whose decision timestamp and policy_label_available_ts precede the held month. Missing/unreadable source rows remain unavailable and are not imputed.
causality.labels_and_portfolio: Source-aligned rich-policy labels are identical across families where identities overlap. Invalid or unresolved paths are excluded before capacity and never reserve portfolio slots. Costs remain embedded exactly once in policy_net_bps.
causality.execution: The runner imports no live execution client and made no network or exchange-writing calls.

commands: post-run target-free audit: no policy fields in admissions, exact candidate uniqueness, finite mapped EV, and exact dual-50 admission equality
validation.results: Focused tests: 4 passed. June-July constrained replay: C0 refit 183 trades at +264.05 bps/trade; S/R 438 at +188.09; E2 298 at +186.97; S/R+E2 383 at +201.23. No arm is promoted.
